question: Which size is right for the OpenAlex JSON Lines snapshot: the docs say about 626 million records and 745 GB for the September 2026 release, the 2026-10-14 manifest says 586176148 records and 755513952946 bytes?
why: data-apis/openalex chaining quotes the docs figures; the combined manifest of the 2026-10-14 release reports different totals, and its works entry reports 464765485 records and 675298563638 bytes against about 615 GB in the docs.
